name: donchian-tune-phase1-base
description: Base Params for layered Donchian tuning (Phase 1 = entry edge). Load this profile, then run a dashboard sweep with matrix only on the dimensions you are testing—keep risk fixed here. Suggested Phase-1 matrix (<=400 cells): donchian_period [10,20,30], ema_trend [0,50,100], use_adx_filter [false,true], adx_min [15,20,25], use_volume_filter [false,true], vol_mult [1.1,1.3] → 216 combos; split or drop one level if needed. Phase 2: lock winners, sweep stop_loss_pct/take_profit_pct or use_atr_sizing + ATR fields + use_trailing_stop. Phase 3: add use_htf_confirm, use_donchian_rsi + rsi_buy_max/sell_min.

changelog.message: rebaseline performance with walk-forward + final holdout OOS
